origine.title: The Pink Ferrari n°20
origine.subtitle: I was 4 years old. It marked me forever.
origine.description: I remember that racing Ferrari, immense and pink. At 4 years old, facing it, I didn't dream of owning one someday. I dreamed of merging with its power. Forty years later, I have four in my workshop. They're not here to be admired. They create.

atelier.title: The Workshop
atelier.subtitle: Four Ferraris. 1,200-kilo instruments.
atelier.description: In my workshop, these cars are tools. 1,200 kilos of metal that leave imprints on canvas. Every acceleration, every braking, every controlled drift produces something I cannot reproduce by hand. That's the irreplicable gesture I'm seeking.

creations.title: Two Forms, One Process
creations.subtitle: Unique Canvases & Documentary Photographs
creations.description: The canvases are born from the Ferrari's direct passage on the surface. Industrial paint, friction, heat. The result is final. The photographs capture this moment of creation. The instant when movement becomes matter.

photographies.title: Three Photographic Series
photographies.subtitle: Imprints • Workshop • Projections
photographies.description: The imprints show the marks left by the wheels and body. The workshop reveals the cars at rest, between sessions. The projections freeze the controlled violence of the process. Each series documents a different facet of creation.

conceptCarArt.title: Ferrari Live Performance: Creation Becomes Spectacle
conceptCarArt.subtitle: A stage. A 10-meter canvas. A Ferrari.
conceptCarArt.description: For 45 minutes, I direct the car like an instrument. Each movement projects paint onto the canvas. The audience watches the artwork being created live, in the deafening noise of the V12 engine. At the end, the canvas is unique. It cannot be redone.

acquerir.title: Own a Trace, Not a Reproduction
acquerir.subtitle: Numbered Limited Editions — Museum Quality
acquerir.description: These works are not printed: they document a unique instant when a Ferrari painted under my impulses. A2, A3, A4 formats. Professional black or aluminum framing. Fine Art printing by Toulouse laboratory.

histoire.title: From the Pink Ferrari n°20 to Four Grey Ferraris
histoire.subtitle: 1985 - 2025: 40 Years of Obsession
histoire.description: A child fascinated by a racing Ferrari. Years of sketches, models, dreams. Then one day, the decision: no longer look at Ferraris. Use them to create. This is the story of a quest that transforms admiration into action.

home.livePerformance: Ferraris create live at the workshop

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.subtitle: Three photographic series
gallery.intro: These images document the creation process. There is never a "second take".

empreintes.title: Imprints
empreintes.description: The marks left by the wheels, body, chassis. Industrial paint under pressure. Each contact produces a different result.

atelier.title: Workshop
atelier.description: The Ferraris at rest, between work sessions. Four cars waiting for their next passage on canvas.

projections.title: Projections
projections.description: Frozen movement. Paint splatters on walls, floor, canvases. The controlled violence of the gesture.

shop.title: Available Works
shop.subtitle: Art Photographs — Limited Editions
shop.intro: These photographs capture the moment when the Ferrari created the canvas. Fine Art Giclée printing, museum quality.
